card.name: The "ne" in neoplasia and neoplasm
card.fires_on: The piece "ne" partway through medical words, mostly in neoplasia or neoplasms after a describing word like endocrine, histiocytic or myeloproliferative. It also fires weakly on "ne" in some drug names.
